product: MANAGE no longer requires USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA on the same object
tagline: The MANAGE privilege no longer requires a usage privilege (USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA) on the object where MANAGE is granted.
what_it_does: The MANAGE privilege no longer requires a usage privilege (USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA) on the object where MANAGE is granted. This change makes MANAGE behave more consistently with object ownership. Previously, MANAGE on a catalog or schema took effect only if you also held the appropriate usage privileges on that object.
why_it_matters: Securable objects In Unity Catalog, data and metadata live in a top level container called a metastore.
plain_summary: The MANAGE privilege no longer requires a usage privilege (USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA) on the object where MANAGE is granted. This change makes MANAGE behave more consistently with object ownership.
key_takeaway: The MANAGE privilege no longer requires a usage privilege (USE CATALOG or USE SCHEMA) on the object where MANAGE is granted.
